info.title: How Smoking Affects Hearing
info.subtitle: Ways tobacco exposure is linked to your ears

rows.title: Reduced blood flow
rows.desc: Nicotine can narrow vessels feeding the inner ear

rows.title: Less oxygen
rows.desc: Carbon monoxide competes with oxygen in the blood

rows.title: Higher hearing-loss risk
rows.desc: Smokers show more hearing loss in studies

rows.title: Secondhand smoke
rows.desc: Passive exposure is linked to hearing risk too

rows.title: Quitting helps
rows.desc: Lowering exposure protects the hearing you have
